items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: the music box is right on the corner where Stein's closing store is now.

ctx.x: Well, that's, the music box is right on the corner where Stein's closing store is now.
Oh, yeah, down on Canal. That's right, Stein, that's what, uh.

In Carondelet. Yeah, Carondelet. Canal and Carondelet. I went up there playing with Eddie Jackson. I know you heard of Eddie Jackson. Oh, yeah, bass player, yeah. Yeah. Well, we had, up there with Eddie Jackson, that's when I went up there and, uh, I found, I found octave up there. Octave was playing piano up there.
